dct_description_sm: This study is an in-campaign poll of the 2022 Ontario General Election. The poll was conducted between April 29 and May 1, 2022. A sample of 1501 Ontarians aged 18+ was interviewed online (1001 through the Ipsos I-Say panel and non-panel sources) and by live-operator telephone interview (500 through landline and cellphones). Online respondents earned a nominal incentive for their participation. Weighting was employed to ensure the sample’s composition reflected the adult population according to 2016 Census data. Respondents provided information on likelihood of voting, government and party preferences, voting intentions, party leadership, and party leadership traits.
